title: S.B. 'High C' Foster puts him on trumpet
summary: His teacher S.B. Foster, a trumpet player, woke him early to listen to practice and moved him to trumpet at about 14; Hawkins stayed at Tuggle from kindergarten through twelfth grade.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Do you remember at that point that you actually started playing trumpet?
At that point, no. I didn't pay too much attention to trumpet. I could pick it up and play scales on it.
Right.
My teacher at that time, he was a trumpet player.
And who was he?

S.B. Foster. We used to call him 'High C' Foster. Yeah. And, going out on parade one day, when he came back after the parade, he took me and put me on trumpet. Before that, he used to come over my house like 5:00 in the morning and knock on the window. My mother would wake me up and say Professor Foster's out there waiting for you.
So, he used to carry me over to the school while he practices before he played the
bucle for the students to get up. See, it was, the school was a boarding school. See?
Right.
So, he used to, I was so small, he used to sit me up there on a shelf so I could hear him practicing. So, that's, I guess that's how I got interested in trumpet - just listening at him play.
So, at one time, he got short of trumpets. And, he just took me off another instrument and put me on trumpet. And then, I just went from there.
Okay. And about how old were you at this time that you began playing trumpet?
Well, I don't know. I think at about 14.
About 14.
Right.
And what was the name of your school?
Tuggle Institute.
Tuggle Institute.
Right.
And you were there for how many years?
I was there until my eleventh grade, my twelfth grade.
About twelfth grade.
Right.
And you started there at.....?
I started at kindergarten.
Started at kindergarten and went straight through until the twelfth grade.
Right.
